answer: Reputation fuel with a hard replenishment ladder: an identity acts only while holding credits that every vote or attestation burns by one. Credits cannot transfer; they refill only through timed, attestable tasks whose difficulty climbs a rising ember curve per account. A farm's k fakes each carry their own gauge and climb the same ladder alone, paying the same escalating cost. Idle accounts leak fuel at a fixed rate, so parked clones drain to zero and freeze on the gale of abandoned keys. Task logs are public and replayable; the marginal atlas of new capacity costs real time, not keys.
